description: This Java class 'QueryFilterCriteriaFactory' provides methods for creating and manipulating query filter criteria, including parsing filter strings, restricting criteria by namespaces, and handling RQL expressions within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: QueryFilterCriteriaFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating query filter criteria, supporting RQL parsing and namespace restrictions.

methods.name: modelBased
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the model-based QueryFilterCriteriaFactory.

methods.name: filterCriteriaRestrictedByNamespaces
methods.description: Creates filter criteria restricted to specified namespaces.

methods.name: filterCriteria
methods.description: Creates filter criteria from a filter string, returning a default if null.

methods.name: restrictByNamespace
methods.description: Combines namespace filter criteria with existing filter criteria.

methods.name: namespaceFilterCriteria
methods.description: Creates criteria for filtering by namespaces.

methods.name: mapCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into criteria, handling exceptions.
